items.title: Monta Ellis Named General Manager At Alcorn State
items.content:
Monta Ellis will serve as the general manager of Alcorn State's basketball program, the school announced on Friday.

Alcorn State finished 9-23 last season.

"I've been coaching and training kids for the last 10 years, and I've seen a lot of kids that could play and didn't get scholarships," said Ellis. "I just think it's an opportunity for kids like that and also to give back to the state of Mississippi, trying to bring a lot of in-state kids to keep them at home versus letting them go out of state and to other colleges."

Alcorn State athletic director E. D'Wayne Robinson said that Ellis adds credibility to the program. 

"It's almost like an endorsement from someone that endorses a brand product," Robinson said. "There are certain people out there that it raises the level of respect for that product. And with Monta having the type of gravitas that he has from being a player -- he's been a good guy over the years -- the program benefits from his brand."

Ellis' son, Monta Ellis Jr., is also a 2028 recruit with multiple Division I offers.

items.title: Garrison Mathews Signs With Olimpia Milan
items.content:
Garrison Mathews confirmed that he has signed with Olimpia Milan on Friday.

"I'm excited about the opportunity," he said in an interview with local media. "I didn't think I'd ever play [overseas], but I got a couple calls with some great offers that were too hard to pass up."

Mathews played seven seasons in the NBA with the Wizards, Rockets, Hawks, and Pacers.

The shooting guard averaged 5.2 points in 15 games for the Pacers last year.

items.title: Taelon Peter Signs Training Camp Deal With Spurs
items.content:
Taelon Peter signed a training camp deal with the San Antonio Spurs, sources told Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.

Peter averaged 4.5 points in 38 games with the Pacers last season.

Peter was drafted with the 54th pick in the 2025 NBA Draft.

items.title: Alondes Williams, Wizards Agree To Exhibit-10 Deal
items.content:
The Washington Wizards signed Alondes Williams to an Exhibit-10 contract, reported Chris Haynes.

With Williams exhausting his Two-Way eligibility, he can sign a standard contract or a G League deal after training camp. 

Williams averaged 11.0 points and 6.3 rebounds in four games last season with the Wizards.

items.title: Josh Broghamer Joins Sean Sweeney's Staff With Magic
items.content:
The Orlando Magic hired Josh Broghamer as an assistant coach on Sean Sweeney's staff, reported Marc Stein of The Stein Line.

Broghamer coached Cooper Flagg during the 2025 Summer League and ran his pregame workouts under Jason Kidd last season.
